authorization.scope: bounded two-node single-variable A/B with rollback

preflight.service_state_before_run: stopped (both compute apps zero, endpoint unreachable)

frozen_pins.engine: vLLM DSpark lane recipe @ dbdd8ce123e881be6323f21fa387679c88da3df6 (control base)
frozen_pins.topology: TP=2 across two DGX Spark nodes

hypothesis.statement: Backporting the pinned upstream vision routing/capture-host-sync change improves low-concurrency decode throughput by routing image placeholder rows with a dedicated bias and avoiding a host sync during CUDA graph capture, without regressing text-only or vision correctness.
hypothesis.primary_metric: median C1 decode tok/s across 3 measured reps after warmup, canonical fixture
hypothesis.success_threshold: median C1 improvement >= 10 percent vs control, with 100 percent deterministic-text and real-image correctness, zero errors, zero restarts, no graph fallback, no Xid/OOM, no thermal breach
hypothesis.on_success: run the full C1/C2/C4/C8/C16 ladder once on the treatment build
hypothesis.on_failure: roll back to control file state, restart, re-verify service, preserve a terminal negative receipt; no further optimization

source_lock.method: exact-file-state at pinned upstream commit 61a4749b291630a2a675a9f48458fbff7ab1bd59; NOT a raw git apply of its diff
source_lock.reason: the pinned commit's diff does not apply cleanly onto the lane base because two intermediate upstream commits also touched these files; the routing change depends on definitions introduced by those intermediates, so the minimum coherent unit is the three files' exact state at the pinned commit
functional_delta_summary: image placeholder token rows routed with a dedicated VL top-k bias and no hash-table lookup; text rows keep the stock path
mixed text/image batches split before routing
CUDA graph capture avoids the host-synchronizing item() call via a stream-capture guard
MegaMoE forward wraps router compute to select the split routing path

steps: stop the lane-owned two-node service with the proven stop script
restore the three control files by exact SHA-256 on the head recipe tree
restart via the proven start script (it syncs patches to the worker before launch)
verify /v1/models, deterministic text, and real-image correctness before declaring rollback complete

stop_conditions: ownership conflict or unknown heavy workload appears on either node
OOM event, Xid error, or thermal breach
CUDA graph fallback detected in server logs
service instability (endpoint unreachable, rank loss, or crash loop)
correctness drift in deterministic text or real-image gates
any single-arm completion token count or prompt token count deviates from the fixture contract

measurement_plan.warmup: one unmeasured canonical request per arm before measured reps
measurement_plan.per_arm: 3 measured C1 reps (400 completion tokens), streaming TTFT per rep, usage objects recorded, per-request wall and tok/s
measurement_plan.extra_gates: deterministic text correctness, real 1x1 red-image correctness without answer disclosure, graph mode from logs, thermals per rep, restart count, draft acceptance metrics when exposed
measurement_plan.optional_diagnostic_only: 256/128-token rows clearly labeled diagnostic, excluded from the decision metric
measurement_plan.prior_control_reference: C1 median 48.7 tok/s (45.6-54.3 range), TTFT median 0.323 s from the earlier full frozen-recipe ladder
